answer_text: Based on the clinical guideline, it is recommended to recheck the patient's kidney function, specifically creatinine and eGFR, at roughly 1-2 weeks after starting or up-titrating lisinopril. This allows for monitoring of any changes in kidney function that may occur as a result of the medication.
